rules.text: This is a {kind} set; your goal ({goal}) needs a {wanted} set.
rules.method: it is a {kind} set and the study needs a {wanted} set

rules.text: Its languages ({entry_languages}) do not include any you asked for ({wanted_languages}).
rules.method: its languages ({entry_languages}) do not cover {wanted_languages}

rules.text: It covers a language you asked for (overlap: {overlap}).
rules.method: it covers {overlap}

rules.text: Its languages are unknown in the catalog, so the match with {wanted_languages} cannot be checked.
rules.method: its languages are not recorded in the catalog

rules.text: Possibly seen in training: its tasks are dated {first} to {last}, all before your model's cutoff ({cutoff}).
rules.method: its tasks ({first} to {last}) all predate the model's {cutoff} cutoff, so contamination is possible

rules.text: Tasks are dated {first} to {last}: some come after your model's cutoff ({cutoff}), some before, so part of it may have been seen in training.
rules.method: its tasks run from {first} to {last}, only partly after the model's {cutoff} cutoff

rules.text: All tasks are dated {first} to {last}, after your model's cutoff ({cutoff}).
rules.method: all its tasks ({first} to {last}) postdate the model's {cutoff} cutoff

rules.text: Contamination unknown: the catalog has no task dates for it, so it cannot be compared with your model's cutoff ({cutoff}).
rules.method: it has no task dates, so overlap with the model's {cutoff} cutoff is unknown

rules.text: It needs containers to run its tasks and you chose a laptop.
rules.method: it needs containers, which a laptop makes harder

rules.text: Whether it needs containers is unknown in the catalog; you chose a laptop.
rules.method: whether it needs containers is not recorded

rules.text: It needs x86_64 images and you chose a laptop, which may not be x86_64.
rules.method: it needs x86_64 images

rules.text: You require a license and the Hub states none for it (unknown).
rules.method: it states no license

rules.text: A license is stated: {license}.
rules.method: it carries the {license} license

rules.text: Public results exist to compare with: {public_source} ({public_entries} entries).
rules.method: public results exist for comparison ({public_source}, {public_entries} entries)

rules.text: The catalog lists no public results for it, so there is nothing to compare with.
rules.method: the catalog lists no public results for it

rules.text: The console has an importer that reads it: {importer}.
rules.method: the console imports it with the {importer} importer

rules.text: No importer in the console is recorded as reading it (importer is null in the catalog).
rules.method: no importer is recorded for it

rules.text: You asked to compare with public runs: this set can be imported and compared in the console.
rules.method: it is importable, which allows a comparison with public runs

rules.text: It is gated: access needs a request on the Hub.
rules.method: it is gated

rules.text: Whether it is gated is unknown in the catalog.
rules.method: whether it is gated is not recorded

rules.text: It has {rows} rows, at least the {tasks_needed} needed to detect {detect_points} points (basis: {size_basis}).
rules.method: it has {rows} rows, enough for the {tasks_needed} needed to detect {detect_points} points

rules.text: It has only {rows} rows, fewer than the {tasks_needed} needed to detect {detect_points} points; repeats would have to make up the rest (basis: {size_basis}).
rules.method: it has only {rows} rows, fewer than the {tasks_needed} needed, so repeats make up the rest

rules.text: Its size is unknown in the catalog, so it cannot be checked against the {tasks_needed} rows needed.
rules.method: its size is not recorded

rules.text: Cost unknown: the lab has no costed runs to estimate from, so your budget was not applied.
rules.method: the cost could not be estimated from recorded runs

rules.text: The full design would cost about ${full_cost} and take about {full_hours} h ({estimate_basis}); a subset of {tasks} tasks x {repeats} repeats fits your limits at about ${cost} and {hours} h.
rules.method: the design was cut to a subset of {tasks} tasks x {repeats} repeats to fit the budget and time

rules.text: The full design ({tasks} tasks x {repeats} repeats) is about ${cost} and {hours} h ({estimate_basis}), within your limits.
rules.method: the full design fits the budget and time (about ${cost}, {hours} h)

rules.text: Even the smallest design (at least {min_tasks} tasks, one repeat) would exceed your limits: about ${cost} and {hours} h ({estimate_basis}).
rules.method: even the smallest design exceeds the budget or time
